hooks.command: echo '=== SESSION START ==='; echo 'Rules: grep before cat | finish tasks before stopping | never delete (archive instead) | never push without instruction'; if git rev-parse --git-dir > /dev/null 2>&1; then echo '--- Recent checkpoints ---'; git log --oneline -5 2>/dev/null; fi; if [ -f 'tasks/lessons.md' ]; then echo '--- Lessons (read these) ---'; cat tasks/lessons.md; fi

if git rev-parse --git-dir > /dev/null 2>&1; then CHANGES=$(git status --porcelain 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$CHANGES" ]; then git add -A && git commit -m "auto-checkpoint: session end $(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M')" --quiet && echo 'Checkpoint saved.'; else echo 'Clean — nothing to checkpoint.'; fi; else echo 'No git repo. Changes not checkpointed.'; fi; echo 'Next task? Run /clear first.'
